record.edic_text:
4469 rhaka {rhak-ah'}

of Aramaic origin cf 07386; TDNT - 6:973,983; n

AV - Raca 1; 1

1) empty, i.e. a senseless, empty headed man
2) a term of reproach used among the Jews in the time of Christ

same.cexp: 拉加，蠢人或廢物（蔑視辱罵的壞話）（#太 5:22|）
